title: Structured-output robustness pack
acceptance: Cases where a model changes its mind, must pick a tool, or lacks an input, each requiring valid structured output
Regression and holdout splits, expected results and an index entry
Deterministic fixtures prove the grader; no model is needed to test the pack
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Fixture or regression for each acceptance item; npm test; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 in the evaluation roadmap plan (owner request). Not a measurement.
